items.title: Police Scotland investigate Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell’s visit to Balmoral

Police Scotland said it had received “information” and inquiries were at a “very early stage” into the time the disgraced royal spent with the late paedophile financier at Balmoral. The energy company hailed a “banner quarter” on Friday, with its underlying ​replacement ⁠cost profit – a key measure of its income – almost quadrupling to $8.46bn (£6.3bn), from $2.2bn ​a year ​ago.
